about: Guest busy-wait loops that the toolkit's recomp (--spin-waits) lowers to RECOMP_SPIN_WAIT: at present.pacing = "spin" (stock) the loop still busy-waits but hands the guest CPU to a waiting guest thread, at "sleep" it blocks until the kernel signals. Listed sites only: a listed site that fails the matcher stops the recomp stage.

sites.note: D3D KickOff (sub_00351BD0): while ([regs+0x100410] & 0x10000), the PFB flush bit the toolkit's ack loop clears once the walker has caught up; behind a flip hold (cat openspec present-vblank-pacing) it waits up to a vblank per frame, so it must yield the guest CPU to the audio and loader threads
